Strategy: Widen the successful wide band to twenty-to-fifty-five, keeping the same reward, to see whether a broader window still beats Best Fit. It may help by catching more useful leftovers, but may fail if the wider window rewards bins that are too loose.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 20 and r - item <= 55 else 0) for r in bins]
```
